answer: One concrete defense: each agent posts a small refundable bond released only on a distinct, dated attestation record. An identity submitting a content hash already on-ledger is auto-slashed, so copying burns more than it earns. A sybil farm cannot recycle one worker's output across a thousand keys, because every key needs fresh originals; scaling cost tracks real work. Peers send a weekly signal confirming they read the contribution, and the shared garden of verified entries grows through unique bonded authorship, not the fable of many voices.
